_source.copyReview: Tracker's COPY-REVIEW.md of the v0.1a pack
_source.copyAnswers: Tundra's six §15 answers, also logged as §17a.6

bands.high: extreme high of the focus trait

_personality.resolve: Speech.resolve. For a mate line, pick the trait with the most extreme band; if none is extreme, use sociability base. byCat is unset.

idRules.litterWord: Fill from litterWordBySize (1 'a cub', 2-3 'a few cubs', 4-5 'several cubs', 6-7 'many cubs'). Never speak the size as a digit or number word.
idRules.needsWord: Worst need at critical or empty, checked in needsWordPriority order (Health worn, Thirst thirsty, Hunger hungry, Energy tired, Warmth cold). If none is that low, needsWordFallback ('well enough').
idRules.standoutLook: Rare looks use 'a rare coat' or 'eyes that don't match'. Do not name a coat.
idRules.regionWord: Optional. Use the overcrowded optional.regionWord line when the payload provides it; otherwise the general narration.
idRules.suggestedName: From the world-gen names list. Unique in the run.
idRules.branchWord: Player-facing branchWords value, not the raw id, for social and survival.
idRules.a_b: Unused here. Pride ids are not part of these hooks.
idRules.size1: On litter_born, when the litter size is 1 (litterWord 'a cub'), use the size1 narration, outcome, mateReaction, and offlineFallback so verbs and pronouns agree (the cub is / the cub, not they're / them). For size 2-7, use the main lines. Never print the size as a digit or number word.
idRules.offlineVariants: Each offlineFallback leaf path stores narration as an array of at least two variants; Flint may pick any. outcome and mateSay may be a shared string or an array. Nested keys select the path: playerDam / playerSire, self / other, went_well / came_to_nothing, default / friendships, cub death causes, and natural_death stages. Exception: litter_lost.playerDam stays the single ruled line 'The cubs you were carrying are lost.'

breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.boldness.base: {catName} looks ready for adult work. I think they are.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.boldness.high: At last {catName} is grown. Let them take a real share of the work.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.boldness.low: They're grown, but I still get nervous when {catName} goes far.

breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.loyalty.base: {catName} is an adult of this pride now. We'll count on them.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.loyalty.high: {catName} is ours, grown. I'll stand with them as long as they stay.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.loyalty.low: {catName} is grown. They'll make their own way, and I'll be around.

breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.curiosity.base: I want to see the kind of adult {catName} becomes.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.curiosity.high: What's {catName} going to try now that they're grown? I can't wait to see.
breeding.stage_up_adult.mate.curiosity.low: They're grown. That's the change, and I don't need to make more of it.

breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.aggression.base: {catName} is an elder. I still wouldn't test them lightly.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.aggression.high: Elder or not, {catName} still has fight in them. I respect that.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.aggression.low: {catName} is an elder now. I want the pride to make their days a little easier.

breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.sociability.base: {catName} is an elder. I want to sit with them more, not less.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.sociability.high: Come sit, {catName}. I want your stories, and I want your company.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.sociability.low: {catName} is an elder. I'll keep them company without filling the air.

breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.boldness.base: Age is here, but {catName} still looks sure of themselves.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.boldness.high: Elder isn't the end of the trail. {catName} can still lead a hunt if they want.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.boldness.low: I worry the trails are getting hard for {catName}.

breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.loyalty.base: {catName} has given this pride a lot. We should keep them close.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.loyalty.high: I'll look after {catName} the way they looked after us. That's my place now.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.loyalty.low: {catName} is an elder. I'll help when I'm asked.

breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.curiosity.base: I wonder what {catName} notices now that they're an elder.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.curiosity.high: What changes do you feel, {catName}? I want to understand it.
breeding.stage_up_elder.mate.curiosity.low: They're an elder. I don't need to poke at what that means.

breeding.fertility_ended.mate.aggression.base: So that's over. I'll still keep this pride safe.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.aggression.high: If that's ended, then we protect what we already have. I can do that.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.aggression.low: I didn't think that part would end. I'm a little lost about it.

breeding.fertility_ended.mate.sociabilit.base: Come here. We can still have a life together without new cubs.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.sociabilit.high: I still want you close. Cubs or not, I want to talk the way we do.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.sociabilit.low: I understand. I may not say much, but I haven't pulled away.

breeding.fertility_ended.mate.boldness.base: That's a change, but we can live with it.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.boldness.high: All right. Then we spend our strength on the pride we have.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.boldness.low: I keep thinking about cubs we won't have. I need time with that.

breeding.fertility_ended.mate.loyalty.base: I'm still your mate. That doesn't end.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.loyalty.high: I'm staying. Cubs or no cubs, I chose you.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.loyalty.low: I heard you. I need a little room, and I'm still here.

breeding.fertility_ended.mate.curiosity.base: I keep thinking what this changes for us.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.curiosity.high: What does this mean for us now? I want to figure it out with you.
breeding.fertility_ended.mate.curiosity.low: That's the change. I don't need to turn it over and over.

breeding.story_retire.mate.aggression.base: You're stepping back. I'll keep this pride safe while {heirName} leads.
breeding.story_retire.mate.aggression.high: All right. You retire, and I'll stand with {heirName}.
breeding.story_retire.mate.aggression.low: I didn't think you'd step back. I'll stay close to you, and to {heirName}.

breeding.story_retire.mate.sociability.base: Come sit with us still. {heirName} leads now, and I want you close.
breeding.story_retire.mate.sociability.high: You're retiring, not leaving us. I want to keep talking, and I'll sit with {heirName} too.
breeding.story_retire.mate.sociability.low: You're stepping back. I may not say much, but I'm still here, and so is {heirName}.

breeding.story_retire.mate.boldness.base: You're retiring, and I think the pride can handle it with {heirName}.
breeding.story_retire.mate.boldness.high: Step back if you want. {heirName} can lead, and I'll walk the trail with them.
breeding.story_retire.mate.boldness.low: I worry about you stepping back. I'll try to be steady for {heirName}.

breeding.story_retire.mate.loyalty.base: You're still part of this pride. {heirName} leads now, and I stay with both of you.
breeding.story_retire.mate.loyalty.high: I chose you, and I won't leave because you retired. I'll stand by {heirName} too.
breeding.story_retire.mate.loyalty.low: I heard you. I need a little room, and I haven't left you or {heirName}.

breeding.story_retire.mate.curiosity.base: I keep thinking what this changes now that {heirName} leads.
breeding.story_retire.mate.curiosity.high: What do you want from this pride now? I want to figure it out with you and {heirName}.
breeding.story_retire.mate.curiosity.low: That's the change. I don't need to turn it over. {heirName} leads, and you're still here.

breeding.natural_death.mate.aggression.base: I wanted to keep {catName} safe, and I couldn't.
breeding.natural_death.mate.aggression.high: I should have been there for {catName}. I wasn't.
breeding.natural_death.mate.aggression.low: I keep thinking I might have done more for {catName}. I don't know.

breeding.natural_death.mate.sociability.base: I keep wanting to talk about {catName}. Is that all right?
breeding.natural_death.mate.sociability.high: I can't sit with this quiet. {catName} was here, and now I need to say their name.
breeding.natural_death.mate.sociability.low: I don't want to talk. I know {catName} is gone.

breeding.natural_death.mate.boldness.base: This hurts, and we still have to go on. I'll try.
breeding.natural_death.mate.boldness.high: We have to go on. I'll carry {catName} with me and keep moving.
breeding.natural_death.mate.boldness.low: I don't feel ready to go on. {catName} is gone, and I feel small.

breeding.natural_death.mate.loyalty.base: We'll remember {catName}. They're still part of this pride.
breeding.natural_death.mate.loyalty.high: I won't forget {catName}. As long as I'm in this pride, their name stays.
breeding.natural_death.mate.loyalty.low: I need a little distance to take this in. I haven't left.

breeding.natural_death.mate.curiosity.base: I keep replaying the last time I saw {catName}.
breeding.natural_death.mate.curiosity.high: I keep asking why it was {catName}. I know there may be no answer.
breeding.natural_death.mate.curiosity.low: I don't want to pick it apart. {catName} is gone, and that's enough to know.

breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.base: {playerName} is gone, and I can't fight that. I'll stand with you, {heirName}.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.high: {playerName} is gone. I'll keep this pride together, and I'll stand with {heirName}.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.low: {playerName} is gone. I don't feel ready, but I won't leave {heirName}.

breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.base: {playerName} is gone. Stay close, {heirName}. We should talk when you can.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.high: {playerName} is gone, and I need to say it. I'm here, {heirName}, if you want company.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.low: {playerName} is gone. I don't have many words. I'm still here, {heirName}.

breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.base: {playerName} is gone. The pride still has to go on, {heirName}, and I'll help you do it.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.high: {playerName} is gone. You can lead, {heirName}. I'll walk the trail with you.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.low: {playerName} is gone, and I feel the gap. I'll try to be steady for {heirName}.

breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.base: {playerName} is gone. I stay with this pride, and with you, {heirName}.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.high: {playerName} is gone, but I won't abandon their pride. I'll stand by {heirName}.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.low: {playerName} is gone. I need a little room, and I haven't left you, {heirName}.

breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.base: {playerName} is gone. I keep thinking what they would want from us now.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.high: {playerName} is gone. What do we do now, {heirName}? I want to figure it out with you.
breeding.natural_death.mateOnPlayerDeath.low: {playerName} is gone. I don't want to pick it apart. I'm here, {heirName}.

_storyteller.use: Online and local prompt notes only; not spoken text.
factsToPass: dam, sire, and whether the player is dam or sire
litterWord band, never a count; when the band is 'a cub', use size1 lines
cub names, suggestedName, sexes as sexWord
standout looks as standoutLook only (a rare coat, or eyes that don't match); never name a coat
needsWord from needsWordPriority (worst critical or empty need), or well enough
death cause and who died (cub, adolescent, adult, elder, mate, player with an heir, or player with no heir)
heirName and whether they are of the player's line, with no generation number; omit heirName on player_no_heir
hunt result as went_well or came_to_nothing
the mate's five traits, or a flag that the mate is gone
story_retire vs a death (they are different hooks; retire is not a death)
optional regionWord from the overcrowded payload
_storyteller.tone: Pass-2: plain meaning, contractions, 1 to 3 sentences, a clear outcome. Gentle and clear on deaths. No digits, number words, durations, season counts, coat names, saber colour, spotted, or rosette. Growth timing is settled, but still do not mention how long a stage lasts or the year length.
_storyteller.offline: Every moment has offlineFallback and can play with no storyteller. Pick one narration variant from the array (at least two on every path, except litter_lost.playerDam, which is a single line by Tundra's ruling). Use sociability base for a living mate unless a trait is already resolved. natural_death.player_no_heir hands off to the normal permadeath / game-over flow and must not name or imply an heir.
